notes.title: 📢 Phaselink Internal Update - Patch Notes 📢
notes.notes:
Greetings Volunteers,

Thank you to everyone continuing to explore the alternate dimensions (and report the inevitable… anomalies). Your cooperation keeps Phaselink's mission running smoothly — and keeps you alive. Mostly.

Today's update addresses several issues reported by brave participants:

✅ Fixed an issue where Volunteer Voidboi clipped through the walls during the debriefing sequence. Voidboi has been properly thanked and compensated with a free slice of cake coupon.
✅ Resolved multiple instances where volunteers became stuck on environmental objects in the snowy dimension. Mobility in hazardous terrain is now significantly improved.
✅ Fixed a rare issue preventing the final achievement from unlocking. Completionists, your time has come.

notes.title: Update July 2, 2025
notes.notes:
[h1][b]PHASELINK SYSTEM UPDATE - PATCH NOTES[/b][/h1]

[i]Subject: Incident Response - Field Equipment & Simulation Stability Improvements
Clearance: Volunteer Group 4 and Above[/i]

Phaselink thanks you for your continued participation in dimensional exploration. The following adjustments have been deployed to improve your survival probability and reduce system malfunctions during active expeditions:

[list]
[*] Resolved an issue where volunteers could become trapped in the padlock interface. You should now be able to exit the sequence as intended.
[*] The Backrooms Secret Ending achievement and area should now properly function. Volunteers who meet the criteria can now access the classified zone.
[*] Fixed a critical issue where participants became stuck during the Alien Chase Sequence. Movement should now proceed as designed.
[*] Improved stability in the Save/Load system. Progress should be more reliable, though further refinements are ongoing. Expect future updates.
[*] Fixed collision issues in the Witch Level, where participants could become stuck on environmental objects.
[*] Addressed a problem where keys could not be properly placed in the Witch Level. All keys should now function as intended.
[*] Corrected a logic error in the Maze Puzzle, ensuring proper functionality.
[*] The final achievement should now unlock properly upon completing all required conditions.
[*] Resolved an issue where volunteers could fall off the map during the Final Sequence. Safety boundaries have been reinforced.
[*] Fixed an issue preventing flashlight activation in the Last Level. Visibility tools should now deploy as expected.

[*] Removed unintended duplicate transmissions from Phaselink systems to reduce confusion.
[/list]
[i]End of Transmission[/i]

[b]Your feedback continues to guide operational stability. Report any further anomalies.[/b]

notes.title: Crafting a Witch-Themed Medieval Nightmare
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44832152/937fb3a01b341b706c4bad83e9a5ff7dcd281e4b.jpg[/img]
We are thrilled to unveil a new realm within The Echo Paradox. Set in a bygone era, this addition plunges players into a mysterious village where shadows stretch longer and whispers seem to come from nowhere. This haunting environment is our most intricate yet, combining immersive soundscapes with chilling atmosphere to draw you deeper into the Occult.

We also worked on new sound design. Every creak of wood, distant echo, and chilling murmur has been crafted to heighten your sense of unease and curiosity. As you navigate this timeless village, the ambiance will guide and haunt you in equal measure. This is sound design like you’ve never experienced before.

To give you a taste of what awaits, we’ve prepared a short teaser trailer showcasing glimpses of this eerie world. You can watch the teaser below:
[previewyoutube=QCG00bZ4SUo;full][/previewyoutube]
Finally, we are excited to announce that we are aiming for a March release. The entire team is working tirelessly to ensure this journey into the echoes of the past is unforgettable.

Thank you for your continued support as we bring The Echo Paradox closer to its final form. Stay tuned for more updates, and keep an ear out for those whispers—they might be closer than you think.

notes.title: Expanding the Phaselink Facility
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44832152/952b78880a1f6eae5759d1f07c89e421cab3c6cf.jpg[/img]

Quick update: we are delaying release until [b]Q1 2025.[/b] We initially expected it to be ready by Halloween, but don’t want to rush the finished product.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44832152/bc331aba8d8833e1f017ca9a5c84582d81411b41.jpg[/img]

We’re excited to share a sneak peek of new aspects of the facility you haven't seen before -  where you’ll finally get to explore more of Phaselink Research! This level dives deep into the hidden corridors, laboratories, and restricted areas of the company you’ve only heard whispers about until now.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44832152/c0009cba9fff6fa5a933ad61a52c9821a5c71acf.jpg[/img]

As you explore, you'll uncover the facility's dark secrets—what Phaselink is truly researching, how far they've gone with their interdimensional experiments, and what that means for the volunteers they've sent into alternate dimensions. Expect to find new pieces of lore, unsettling details, and areas that have never been shown before.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44832152/70afaf57f29fa1a84ddff645636a2599cb463d54.jpg[/img]

This isn't just a tour—danger still lurks around every corner. And with more of Phaselink’s technology at your disposal, there may be opportunities to turn the tables... or get caught in something far worse.
Stay tuned for more details, and we can’t wait for you to unravel the mysteries of Phaselink!

Thanks for all your support,

Virtuzilla

notes.title: Developer Update - Frozen Terrors: What comes next?
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44832152/256ad9f9ab4b54868cb3c023f4a10a1473f3b2f0.png[/img]
Dear Candidates, 

Brace yourselves as we take you deep into the heart of the winter mountains, where isolation and chilling winds are your only companions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44832152/07d9c4fe770be495f10d2feaed48360fe03ff5da.jpg[/img]

Imagine vast expanses of snow-covered terrain, where every step crunches underfoot, echoing through the desolate silence. The beauty of the untouched wilderness is a stark contrast to the eerie feeling that something is always watching. In this level, players will navigate treacherous paths, abandoned cabins, and icy caves, each more unsettling than the last.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44832152/0db2959459b27955373dd4a2a30c2f827410f00d.jpg[/img]

While exploring, you'll encounter mysterious tracks and hear whispers carried by the wind. Shadows flicker at the edge of your vision, and you might feel the urge to glance over your shoulder more than once. This level taps into the primal fear of the unknown, as the mountains hold secrets long forgotten by civilization.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44832152/2b04025f2cbffb56d63a0d0f1f958b50d583362b.jpg[/img]

Survival will be key, as resources are scarce, and the environment itself is unforgiving. Keep your wits about you, for not everything that appears human is friendly, and some things are far from it. Legends speak of ancient entities that roam these lands, drawn to the scent of fear and the warmth of life.
Prepare yourselves for an experience that will test your courage and resolve. The Frozen Peaks await, and they are eager to reveal their dark secrets. Will you brave the cold and uncover the truth, or will the mountains claim another lost soul?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44832152/721477578c3d18aef6df36d55055db30250fa4b9.jpg[/img]

Stay tuned for more updates, and get ready to venture into the unknown!

Finally: [b]Thank you for playing the demo![/b] Your feedback has been extremely helpful and we hope the changes in the full release will continue to receive your praise.

Here's what we've been up to since the demo release:
[list]
[*]Added Volumetric Fog
[*]Fixed Ladder issues
[*]Fixed Progression Issues
[*]New puzzles
[*]New levels
[*]New AI
[/list]

notes.title: 👽🔴Traveling to alternate dimensions..👽
notes.notes:
Attention, brave explorers!

This is an official invitation from the Phaselink Group. We are thrilled to announce that The Echo Paradox will be part of the Steam Next Festival! Join us for an exclusive developer live stream where you can dive deep into the eerie and mysterious multiverse of our psychological horror game.

Date & Time: 6/12 - 6PM PST | 8PM CST | 9PM EST

During the live stream, you will get a firsthand look at the game's roadmap, learn about the inspirations and challenges behind its development, and see exclusive gameplay of the demo now available on Steam. This is your chance to ask questions, share your thoughts, and become part of our growing community.

Game Description:
The Echo Paradox is a psychological horror game where you explore alternate universes, each with different haunting entities. Humanity stands on the brink of an unsettling revelation – the multiverse is real, but eerily devoid of life. As a daring volunteer for the Phaselink research group, you embark on a chilling journey, venturing into unknown parallel universes in a desperate quest to find any remnants of human existence.

Don't miss this opportunity to learn more about the terrifying adventures that await in The Echo Paradox. Mark your calendars, follow our Steam page, and get ready to face the unknown.

Play the demo now on Steam!

We can't wait to see you there!

notes.title: New thrills await: Introducing the Jellyfish UAP!
notes.notes:
Hello, fearless gamers!

We're excited to announce a spine-tingling new addition to our acclaimed horror game, "The Echo Paradox" – the Jellyfish UFO! This eerie sighting has been all over the news recently and we took that opportunity to introduce it to the first dimension you enter in The Echo Paradox.

[previewyoutube=UJxt35bNUr0;full][/previewyoutube]

A Glimpse into the Unknown

As you navigate the dark, twisted corridors of "The Echo Paradox," prepare to encounter the Jellyfish UFO – a mysterious entity that defies explanation. Resembling a ghostly jellyfish floating in the deep sea, this UFO brings a unique blend of horror and wonder to our game. Its haunting presence and unpredictable movements will be something to keep your eye out for.

What Lies Ahead

And we're just getting started! Our team is working tirelessly to expand the Alien UFO Dimension with more thrilling content. Expect new challenges, eerie environments, and encounters with otherworldly beings that will test your courage and skills.

Join the Adventure

Ready to dive into the unknown? Wishlist "The Echo Paradox" today and be the first to experience this level. Your feedback is crucial to us, so don't hesitate to share your experiences and suggestions.

Stay tuned for more updates, and thank you for being a part of our gaming community. Let the interstellar horror begin!
